questions.prompt: Explain the difference between a process and a thread, and give one reason to prefer threads.

items.description: A process has its own address space / memory
A thread runs inside a process; a process can have several
Threads in one process share memory and resources
A valid reason to prefer threads (cheaper to create or switch, easy data sharing)

questions.prompt: Your web server's p99 latency doubled right after a deploy. How would you investigate?

items.description: Compare metrics before and after the deploy to confirm and scope the regression
Roll back, or bisect the deploy's changes, to find the cause
Profile or trace slow requests to find where time goes
Names a concrete plausible cause (new query, cache miss, lock contention, GC)
